name: v1.3.0
body:
After minor architectural tweaks and improvements to our training recipe, we're releasing TabDPT v1.3, which is similar to v1.2 but with improved predictive performance. We've also added an option for full probabilistic regression outputs, with helper functions for calculating quantiles and other statistics of the output distributions.

## What's Changed
* Add docstrings to predict functions and normalize to Google docstring format by @j201 in https://github.com/layer6ai-labs/TabDPT-inference/pull/76
* Add tests by @Barry0121 and @j201 in https://github.com/layer6ai-labs/TabDPT-inference/pull/77
* Add BarDistribution class and update TabDPTRegressor for a ScoringBench compatible API by @ikozl090 in https://github.com/layer6ai-labs/TabDPT-inference/pull/75
* Add changes for v1.3 by @j201 in https://github.com/layer6ai-labs/TabDPT-inference/pull/78

## New Contributors
* @ikozl090 made their first contribution in https://github.com/layer6ai-labs/TabDPT-inference/pull/75

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/layer6ai-labs/TabDPT-inference/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0
